title: Conway's Game of Life
tagline: Three rules, a grid of squares, and no players. Then it builds a computer.
description: In 1970 John Conway invented a game nobody plays: set up a grid, apply three rules, and watch gliders, guns and whole computers emerge. Run the board yourself and see why it changed how we think about complexity.
coverAlt: A cartoon grid with a glider pattern of coral cells, one of them smiling
